description: Issue #58 (PROPOSED, not yet finalized): `successes` MUST be <= `trials` (7 successes out of 5 trials is impossible). Note for implementers: this is a cross-field constraint that plain JSON Schema (without a $data reference, which this project's schema does not otherwise use) cannot express, so EvalPort's own raw JSON Schema at spec/schemas/resultset.json accepts this document -- it is the hand-rolled SDK validators (sdk/python/openeval/validate.py, sdk/typescript/src/validate.ts) that enforce it with code SUCCESSES_EXCEED_TRIALS, exactly as they already do for group.parent_group_id's SELF_PARENT and the (test_case_id, run_id, attempt) DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT rule. A conformance implementation MUST perform this same cross-field check itself. A conforming validator MUST REJECT this document.
